title: Fact-Check Verdict I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 48, a FIRST DRAFT (6 Aug 2026, unreviewed by Pieter). Output is a blocking verdict: pass is true only when violations is empty. See prompt.md's Known limitation section before treating this as settled QA policy.

client_references.description: Not used by this function's own checks (client-naming clearance is function 02's job). Carried in the input shape only for symmetry with function 02's contract, since both are invoked by the same _single_draft_qa_review shared body in dispatch.py (round 34's per-draft replacement for the old _aggregate_qa_review).

channel.description: Not currently used to change fact-check behaviour -- every channel is held to the same traceability bar. Present for symmetry with function 02's input contract.

proof_points.description: The {claim, source} pairs function 41's research brief attached to this week's evidence, carried through the drafting handoff. Optional: absent or empty means no citable evidence was available this week, which is a real outcome (function 41's own schema documents the empty case) and not a licence to accept an uncited claim. Present, these are List D -- the only list that is not a standing snapshot of positioning.md, and the one that lets this function check the criterion it was actually written to enforce.

pass.description: True only when violations is empty. No partial pass.
